description: Density of states (total and projected/partial DOS)
workflow: TWO-STEP: 1) SCF on uniform k-mesh → 2) dense k-mesh non-SCF for DOS

step2_dos.description: Non-SCF or SCF with dense k-mesh for accurate DOS

ISMEAR.note: tetrahedron method with Blöchl corrections for accurate DOS

NEDOS.note: number of energy grid points for DOS

EMIN.rule: set to cover valence band, e.g., -10

EMAX.rule: set to cover conduction band, e.g., 10

NBANDS.rule: increase for good coverage of empty states

kpoints.rule: DENSER mesh than SCF, e.g., 2x in each direction

magnetic.note: DOSCAR will contain spin-up and spin-down columns
